2217.note: BNCF Ginori Conti 29.137 c. 13 is a 40x209 mm biglietto of four lines of symbol cipher (seen on the BNCF teca viewer, labelled 13, no gloss or decipherment on it); the Manus record gives no sender, addressee or date (the lead's 1481 comes from the volume, whose c. 9v letter is 4 Aug 1481), and no reading or key match is on record.

seen.where: BNCF TecaDigitale viewer for the whole volume, https://teca.bncf.firenze.sbn.it/ImageViewer/servlet/ImageViewer?idr=BNCF0003827870 (scrolled to the leaf labelled 13 in Chrome, 5 Nov 2026); Manus Online record CNMD 0000159742, https://manus.iccu.sbn.it/risultati-ricerca-manoscritti/-/manus-search/detail/611145 (JSON https://manus.iccu.sbn.it/o/manus-api/title?id=611145).
seen.extent: One strip, 40 x 209 mm, four lines of continuous cipher signs (about 60-70 characters per line) on the recto labelled 13; the verso (stamp 3423197) is blank.
seen.cipher: On the strip labelled 13 I see four lines of unbroken symbol/letter-form cipher, with no word breaks, no interlinear glosses and no plaintext between the lines (zoomed on the image); the leaf before it (c. 12, 'Il Sr Girolamo ha sollecitato l'andata di Messer Ascanio', Manus inv. 3423195) and the leaf after it are ordinary clear letters. Manus: 'A c. 13v, timbro: Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale Firenze. Numero di inventario: 3423197. Il biglietto e in scrittura cifrata.' (physical note 'mm. 40x209; piegatura a biglietto'); no sender, recipient or date is given for it.
